full_judgment: 3. The material facts, relevant for disposal of the appeal, in short, are that the opposite party No.1 filed an Artha Rin Suit as plaintiff against the defendant Nos.1-2 being Artha Rin Suit No. 180 of 2011 in the Court of 2nd Artha Rin Adalat, Dhaka and obtained an ex-parte judgment and decree on 09.01.2012 and 11.01.2012 respectively for realization of money of Tk. 3,35,48,603.26 as on 17.08.2011. The decree holder hank by dint of the said Judgment and decree filed an Anita Jari Case being No. 122 of 2012 before the concerned Executing Court. The decree-holder Bank filed an application for the purposes of execution of the decree passed by the Hon'ble Court below under Order 21 Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure on 21.06.2012. The plaintiff as a decree holder Bank has obtained a ownership certificate over the schedule property in his favour issued by the Court following due process of law as per Section 33 Sub Section 6(Kha) and 7 under Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003. The plaintiff decree holder bank after obtaining the Ownership Certificate through Court filed an application for recovery of Khas possession of the schedule land. The Executing Court was pleased to allow the petition and appointed belief for recovery of the land through Court. The appointed belief could not give possession due to obstacle created by Harb Holdings Ltd, the present petitioner and, as such, pray for police force for assisting and executing the same. Thereafter the plaintiff decree holder Bank impleaded the present petitioner as third party in the aforesaid Artha Jari Case No. 122 of 2012 and have filed a petition on 06.11.2014 under Section 44(I) and 57 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain 2003 for restraining the third Party petitioner from construction of any building or structure in the schedule land until further order.
